profile.role_line: Agricultural engineer, researcher and developer — working across embedded hardware, robotics, IoT, AI models, data analytics and software.
profile.statement: I build intelligent systems that connect hardware, data and software — for agriculture and beyond. My research becomes peer-reviewed papers and working prototypes; my development work becomes dependable web, app and software products.
profile.summary: Agricultural engineer and Research Assistant working on IoT, AI-edge computing and automation for agriculture: poultry, aquaculture (biofloc and fish feeding), irrigation and farm machinery. Alongside research he develops web, app and embedded software, analyses data, and writes scientific papers and technical posts.

research_interests: Tracking agricultural machinery for improved efficiency
Smart technology in the livestock sector
Precision agriculture and agricultural machinery automation
